entries.summary: Prefer PostgreSQL over MongoDB for workloads with relational invariants and cross-entity joins.
entries.body: Postgres offers strong consistency, foreign-key enforcement, and rich indexing that suit transactional data. Reach for document stores only when payloads are genuinely schema-less.

entries.summary: External-side-effect calls (HTTP POSTs, DB writes that aren't naturally unique) should accept an idempotency key so retries are safe.
